He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Temple Owls men's basketball|Temple Owls]]. ==High school career== After attending [[St. Peter's Preparatory School|St. Peter's Prep]] in [[Jersey City, New Jersey]] and [[St. Benedict's Preparatory School|St. Benedict's Prep]] in [[Newark, New Jersey]], Pierre-Louis attended [[Roselle Catholic High School]] in [[Roselle, New Jersey]], where he averaged 15.6 points per game, leading Roselle to an 18–10 record, to the Union County Tournament final and the South Jersey, Non-Public B final.{{cite web|title=Nate Pierre-Louis – 2019–20 MEN'S BASKETBALL ROSTER|url=https://owlsports.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/nate-pierrelouis/11500|website=OwlSports.com|access-date=July 28, 2024}} ==College career== Pierre-Louis attended [[Temple Owls men's basketball|Temple]] coming as a three-star recruit. He played 91 games and averaged 10.9 points, 8.5 rebounds, 3.1 assists and 1.8 steals as a junior before entering the NBA draft.{{cite web|first=Owen|last=McCue|title=Rumph Classic: Temple product Nate Pierre-Louis keeping eyes on NBA dream|url=https://www.cityofbasketballlove.com/news_article/show/1280880|website=CityOfBasketballLove.com|date=August 7, 2023|access-date=July 28, 2024}} ==Professional career== ===South Bay Lakers (2021–2023)=== After going undrafted in the [[2020 NBA draft]], Pierre-Louis joined the [[South Bay Lakers]] on October 23, 2021, after a tryout,{{cite web|title=South Bay Finalizes Training Camp Roster|url=https://southbay.gleague.nba.com/news/south-bay-finalizes-training-camp-roster|website=NBA.com|date=October 23, 2021|access-date=July 28, 2024}} playing 32 games and averaging 9.3 points, 4.5 rebounds, 2.8 assists and 1.7 steals in 27.7 minutes.{{cite web|title=Nate Pierre-Louis Player profile|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/player/Nate-Pierre-Louis/Summary/88851|website=RealGM.com|access-date=July 28, 2024}} In June 2022, Pierre-Louis joined the [[Los Angeles Lakers]] for the [[2022 NBA Summer League]]{{cite web|title=Lakers Announce 2022 Summer League Roster|url=https://www.nba.com/lakers/news/lakers-announce-2022-summer-league-roster|website=NBA.com|date=June 28, 2022|access-date=July 28, 2024}} and on October 11, 2022, he signed for them.{{cite web|first=Dana|last=Gauruder|title=Nate Pierre-Louis Signs Exhibit 10 Deal With Lakers|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2022/10/nate-pierre-louis-to-sign-exhibit-10-deal-with-lakers.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=October 11, 2022|access-date=July 28, 2024}} However, he was waived four days later{{cite web|first=Luke|last=Adams|title=Lakers Cut Shaq Harrison, Jay Huff, Nate Pierre-Louis|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2022/10/lakers-cut-shaq-harrison-jay-huff-nate-pierre-louis.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=October 15, 2022|access-date=July 28, 2024}} and on October 22, he returned to South Bay.{{cite web|title=South Bay Finalizes 2022 Training Camp Roster|url=https://southbay.gleague.nba.com/news/south-bay-finalizes-2022-training-camp-roster|website=NBA.com|date=October 22, 2022|access-date=July 28, 2024}} He played 47 games and averaged 7.3 points, 3.6 rebounds, 1.6 assists and 1.0 steals in 18.4 minutes. On March 29, 2023, he was awarded the [[Jason Collier Sportsmanship Award]].{{cite web|title=Nate Pierre-Louis Wins 2022–23 Kia NBA G League Sportsmanship Award|url=https://gleague.nba.com/news/nate-pierre-louis-wins-2022-23-kia-nba-g-league-sportsmanship-award|website=NBA.com|date=March 29, 2023|access-date=July 28, 2024}} ===Mexico City Capitanes (2023–2024)=== On October 30, 2023, Pierre-Louis joined the [[Mexico City Capitanes]]{{cite tweet|author=CAPITANES|title=Comunicado oficial: Capitanes presenta su roster para el Training Camp 23–24 #SomosCapitanes|number=1719057279763308852|user=CapitanesCDMX|date=October 30, 2023|access-date=October 31, 2023|language=Spanish}} where he played 22 games and averaged 4.9 points, 4.8 rebounds, 1.1 assists and 0.8 steals in 18.2 minutes. ===Long Island Nets (2024)=== On February 27, 2024, Pierre-Louis was traded to the [[Long Island Nets]]{{cite web|title=Long Island Nets Announce Roster Changes|url=https://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/long-island-nets-announce-roster-changes/n-6061844|website=OurSportsCentral.com|date=February 27, 2023|access-date=July 28, 2024}} where he played 11 games and averaged 3.8 points, 4.1 rebounds, 1.1 assists and 0.8 steals in 15.1 minutes. On November 4, he was waived by Long Island.{{cite web|title=Long Island Nets Waive Two Players|url=https://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/long-island-nets-waive-two-players/n-6162408|website=OurSportsCentral.com|date=November 4, 2024|access-date=November 4, 2024}} ===Iowa Wolves (2024)=== On November 18, 2024, Pierre-Louis signed with the [[Iowa Wolves]].{{cite web|title=Wolves Add Nate Pierre-Louis|url=https://iowa.gleague.nba.com/news/wolves-add-nate-pierre-louis|website=NBA.com|date=November 18, 2024|access-date=November 18, 2024}} However, he was waived on November 27.{{cite web|title=2024-2025 Iowa Wolves Transaction History|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/gleague/teams/Iowa-Wolves/4/Transaction_History/2025|website=RealGM.com|access-date=November 28, 2024}} ==Career
